THIS_IS_A_PROJECTION_NOT_A_MEASUREMENT: NVFP4 has no hardware path on Ada (sm_89). Fake-quant latency on a 4090 carries no speedup semantics and is not reported. What follows substitutes an ASSUMED operator-level ratio into THIS PROJECT'S MEASURED operator mix.

three_ceilings.reading: FP8 already captured 97.9% of ITS OWN ceiling. The room a better weight format can still address is the gap between the two ceilings, not the gap to 1.107.

assumed_inputs.nvfp4_realisation_rate: taken equal to FP8's 0.9794 -- OPTIMISTIC. NVFP4 uses group-16 scales, so a GEMM reads 2048x more scale values than per-tensor FP8; the realisation rate can only be lower.

memory.scale_overhead_note: NVFP4 是 group-16 + E4M3 的二级 scale：每 16 个 4-bit 权重配 1 个 8-bit scale = 每权重多 0.5 bit，即 4 -> 4.5 bit，相对 FP8 是 4.5/8 = 0.5625

D2_quality_cost_of_quantising_the_scale.claim: SPEC 4.7 D2: NVFP4's block scale is itself quantized to FP8 E4M3, so the true grid is shifted relative to the FP32-optimal one. This block isolates that cost by holding the E2M1 element grid fixed and only changing the scale format.

verdict.headline: Even at the nominal 2x NVFP4:FP8 GEMM ratio and an optimistic realisation rate, the projected denoise speedup is 1.153x against FP8's measured 1.084x -- a gain of 6.3%, and the end-to-end gain (VAE fp32) is 2.9%.
verdict.why_so_small: GEMM is only 20.4% of denoise and denoise is only 49.6% of end-to-end. The format axis is bounded by the operator mix, not by the format.
verdict.where_nvfp4_does_pay: memory: weights 1.35 -> 0.76 GiB including the group-16 E4M3 scales (56% of FP8, 29% of BF16). That is a deployment benefit, and it is NOT a speed benefit.
verdict.this_is_the_paper_s_own_thesis_applied_f: cause (1): a headline operator-level ratio does not transfer to the stage or the chain. We do not need a Blackwell to say that -- the operator mix already bounds it.
